description_en: Specify an organizational unit (OU) and administrator for the Active Directory (AD) office network (formerly known as workspace)
description_zh: 为AD办公网络（原工作区）指定组织单元OU和管理员
kebab_example: aliyun ecd config-ad-connector-user --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-7784180000 --ou-name example.com/Domain_Controllers --domain-user-name Administrator --domain-password testPassword --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigADConnectorUser

parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AD workspace
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OU in the AD domain. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html to obtain the OU name
parameters.help_zh: AD域的组织单元OU。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311259.html获取
parameters.name: ou_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the AD user that has the permissions to join computers to domains.

After the username is configured, the cloud desktops in the same AD workspace are joined to the specified OU
parameters.help_zh:
具有加域权限的AD用户的用户名。    
此处配置的AD用户需具备将计算机加入域的权限。配置成功后，在对应AD办公网络下创建的云电脑将加入到指定的组织单元OU中
parameters.name: domain_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the AD user that has the permissions to join computers to domains
parameters.help_zh: 具有加域权限的AD用户的密码
parameters.name: domain_password
